record.design: Meta-analysis and meta-regression of the prevalence of skin bleaching
record.finding: Pooled lifetime prevalence of skin bleaching was 27.7%, and 27.1% in Africa, with very high heterogeneity, so the figure is a rough average of unlike samples. The highest prevalence in a subgroup analysis was 51.8%, associated with topical corticosteroid use (the abstract does not say whether this is the share of users who applied steroids); the pooled sample is global, not Black-specific.
record.note: Prevalence and corticosteroid figures from the 12 Nov research file (agent4), which opened the paper; I confirmed the paper exists and its title. Not re-read by me.
